name: ip-api.com Geolocation API
rate_limits: 45 requests/minute per IP. Batch endpoint: 15 requests/minute (up to 100 IPs per batch). Exceeding limits results in HTTP 429; persistent abuse causes permanent IP ban.
notes: Running since 2012. No API key or registration required, ever. Returns country, region, city, zip, lat/lon, timezone, ISP, org, AS number. Batch endpoint allows up to 100 IPs per request. Customizable fields via query parameter to reduce bandwidth. Free tier is HTTP-only (no HTTPS). Commercial use requires paid Pro plan. Rate limit headers X-Rl and X-Ttl provided in responses. Supports JSON, XML, CSV, and serialized PHP output formats.
